title: Chapter 462
paragraphs: Chapter 462
Episode 131. People with good intuition, people with not-so-good intuition (6)
It happened in the blink of an eye.
"Murakan, let's follow them!"
A rapid descent began again. Folding his wings, Murakan let out an irritated cackle.
[Darn, how can they be so fast?]
He was talking about the cradle of stale energy that wrapped around the Proch siblings.
The cradle was much faster and... chaotic, to the extent that it should be described as erratic, than Murakan descending at top speed, leaving a bizarre trail as it fled.
The cradle, which was one, divided into two, holding the siblings separately, and then combined into one again, repeating the spinning motion.
Their vision blurred due to the stale energy, and the cradle looked even more sinister.
[Oh dear, my babies. How much did you miss me that you came looking for me like this, huh?]
The woman's voice was heard again. It wasn't from the huge Bubare's mouth outside, but from the stale energy inside.
Now, Jin and Murakan could be sure that the owner of the voice was Amella.
They also thought she wouldn't kill Lata and Faye immediately.
-If it's not affection?
-It's hard to express in words. I guess I should say she seemed to think of us as toys or playmates. Saying she's bored while wielding a knife.
-Embarrassingly, I once got my forehead cut by such a surprise attack.
Just like the conversation the party had when they entered the military road, and now Amella calling them 'our babies.'
To Amella, the Proch siblings were lovely toys. They weren't something she would easily break.
[Sleep well, our little ones.]
Amella was even singing a lullaby.
It felt like they had entered someone's playful dream because of the lullaby echoing with the swaying cradle and stale energy.
Whooooosh!
Murakan slowed down. The cradle was no longer visible to Jin and Murakan.
[That Amella seems to be quite a headache too. Lately, it seems like everyone we meet is somewhat like that. Zephyrin, that darn guy too.]
Instead of the cradle, they saw a darker and denser mass of stale energy. The cradle had disappeared into it.
[What do you want to do, kid?]
Should they chase beyond the darkness or find another way? There was no need to ponder.

"The effect of the stale energy is a curse. We're immune anyway, and seeing the giant Bubare vomiting breath, it seems to have some physical destructive power, but it doesn't seem unbearable. We'll follow them. But."
[But?]
"Before we can directly communicate with Amella, let's just defend or evade if there are any attacks. No counterattacks."
[What kind of nonsense is that?]
"Do you remember what Amella said as soon as we arrived at the central island?"
-[You guys have been really annoying to me.]
Although it was spoken through the giant Bubare's mouth, it was clearly Amella's voice.
[So what?]
"We can't know exactly what happened between Amella and the Four Powers when they found this place before me. But Amella expressed that they were annoying enough to kill them all."
It wasn't just an expression in words.
Although no casualties have been reported in Runcandel yet, Zipfel, Kinzelo, and Vermont have already suffered irreparable damage.
The reason why the Four Powers gathered here in the first place was to capture Amella.
However, the Four Powers who found the military road not only failed to capture her, but also ended up in a situation where it wouldn't be strange if they had a life-or-death battle with her.
If the expression "annoying" came from an ordinary person, they would think there was a hidden intention, but the opponent is someone presumed to be tainted by 'chaos.'
Amella seemed like she could easily refuse to deal with the Four Powers for such a trivial reason. Comparing her to Yona, for instance.
"There's no need for us to provoke Amella and be included in the list of annoying targets since the others outside are already twisted, right?"
As Jin explained this, Murakan sighed.
[Ha! This Murakan has to be beaten up. How miserable and lamentable.]
"Also, neither Valkas nor Lata heard this story."
By this story, he meant Amella's battle style.
One of the three great mercenaries and the world's best mercenary recognized even by Valkas with his unmatched single ability.
Valkas and Lata had encountered Amella on the battlefield several times, and especially Valkas said that she was better at war than the entire Black King's group.
But there was no mention in their description that Amella used curses or this unheard-of stale energy.

"There were only expressions that her weapon skills and various war equipment usage were unparalleled, and her strategy and tactics were insanely great. They also said that she planted many traps and equipment in various places on the battlefield while moving alone."
[Hmm, that's that. Then, was Amella hiding her abilities?]

"If she hid her abilities to that extent and was able to dominate the Black King's group alone in a war, it would mean Amella is actually close to being a god. It doesn't seem like that, though. In my opinion, there might have been some change in Amella for some reason."
[Change?]
"Amella's chaos and Bubare Gaston's chaos met, and some amplification occurred. And it's working in Amella's favor more than Bubare."
Although it was a judgment based on intuition, it wasn't entirely baseless.
The giant Bubare outside was almost certainly being controlled by Amelia, which is why it didn't seem like she would have created Bubare using curse techniques without a good reason.
In other words, Bubare's curse.
It had no choice but to use his form because it was controlling the power of chaos that Bubare possessed.
Jin was soon able to arrive at this conjecture.
[Hmm, it seems like a leap, but it also seems plausible.]
"It's likely that the reason Amelia is particularly interested in and fond of the Proch siblings is because of chaos."
[Aren't those snake-eyed guys a bit different from your sister and Amelia?]

"They are different. But their father is Smarion Proch, a man who was consumed by chaos and turned into a monster. Maybe a bit of his chaos has rubbed off on the Proch siblings, and Amelia feels an affinity for that."
[Then what about Bubare? Why does he feel an affinity for the Proch siblings, but treat Bubare like that?]

"I don't know. After all, everything I've said so far is just speculation. Well, honestly, Bubare seems to be the type that makes everyone feel repulsed. I don't think there needs to be any other reason to dislike him."
[Oh, my head hurts. We'll only know what your hypothesis is when we meet her in person. Let's go for now. Not attacking back.]
Kwa-ah, thud! Kugugung...!
The distant explosions from outside were getting more intense. The intensity of the battle between the giant forces and Amelia was increasing.
Concentrating for a moment, they could hear the sounds of the high-ranking individuals struggling.
"Spread the defense line based on the executioners...! I'll open the way!"
"The captain is down, retreat! The curse is coming!"
"Follow the greatest warriors and the kings, kill all the enemies who turn their backs!"
"Don't miss the fire of the fire tower! If you get out of the fire, you'll be eroded by the curse...!"
Despite the distance, their voices were transmitted quite clearly. It was as if Amelia had decided to listen to their reactions for a moment.
[Eight, we should just kill them all, leaving our cute ones behind. That would be better, right, cuties?]
Amelia, who spoke like that, was full of confidence.
She was fighting against all four major forces and didn't think of losing, but rather believed that she would surely win.
'Just listening to the voices of the people outside, it seems Amelia is dominating the situation.'
That's why Jin was even more convinced. For some reason, Amelia was in a state where she possessed much greater power than usual.
Although not all of the top-ranking individuals from each faction were sent, there were very few people in the world who could single-handedly overpower this many opponents.
Considering that the Gaipa region is her base, it was absolutely impossible when compared to the explanations of Valkas and Lata.
Murakan's black wings silently cut through the curse.
As they entered the chunk of curse where the cradle had disappeared, complete darkness spread beyond the hazy view. Even forming a flame in their palm did not lighten the darkness.
They continued to move forward, with their inner senses wide open and their nerves on edge.
They used the distant sound of singing, humming, and the seemingly happy whispering coming from inside as a guide.
[Lulu, you're the older brother, you're the younger brother. I am the Devil King!]
It sounded like a child engrossed in a doll play talking to herself. It gave them the chills, but at the same time, it reminded them of Yona and made them feel strangely sympathetic.
Amelia's humming was getting closer. And as it got closer, the darkness of the curse gradually cleared.
It was because there was a shining space far away. Jin and Murakan were naturally able to realize that the shining space was the core of the curse that covered the entire island.
Amelia was sitting in the middle.
She was wearing a camouflage suit commonly used by mercenaries. However, the suit made of grass and branches was so large that it couldn't be compared to ordinary items.
As a result, Amelia looked as if she was not wearing clothes, but rather completely covered by a round bush.
The two hands sticking out of the camouflage were fiddling with small wooden dolls.
There were three wooden dolls in total, and Jin immediately recognized what they each represented.
The Proch siblings and Bubare.
The real-life counterparts corresponding to each doll were standing in front of Amelia, moving according to her touch.
'But... Bubare is like a soul, without substance.'
While the Proch siblings were in their true form, Bubare took on the form of a shining soul.

And Bubare's doll was punching far away from the Proch siblings' dolls (it seemed to be the behavior of the giant Bubare outside), while the Proch siblings' dolls were drinking tea or having a conversation.
Murakan transformed into a human and set foot on the ground with Jin. As they did so, Amelia followed up by turning her head with a start.
She had no idea that Murakan and Jin had come this far.
[...Huh? What? What are you guys? How are you alive when you've come this far?]
Amelia spoke with her eyes turning red. She tilted her head, seemingly unable to understand.
